name: ih_assets
description: Things you own (games, DVDs, toys, devices, books) with a low and high resale value each, totals and a value-over-time history. Own database, token-protected API, page. Publishes sensor.assets_low and sensor.assets_high only in live mode.
restore: Stop the add-on. The list and history live in the add-on's own database (/data/ih.db, daily snapshots in /data/backup) and are lost on uninstall. In dry mode nothing in Home Assistant depends on it; in live mode the two sensors stop updating.
